source: Uniswap v2-periphery UniswapV2Library.getAmountOut: amountOut = (amountIn*997*reserveOut) / (reserveIn*1000 + amountIn*997). expected_out_wei computed by exact 256-bit integer arithmetic (the canonical on-chain result).
kind: canonical numeric reference values (facts); no code copied
note: Amounts/reserves in wei (1e18 = 1 token). The repo fn works in normalized f64 units, so the test divides wei by 1e18 before calling it; for realistic trades f64 matches the exact integer result to ~1e-16 relative. Dust trades (sub-1e-6 token output) lose precision under f64 normalization and are intentionally excluded.
